tracks.title: Nepali Language
tracks.description: A systematic, cumulative course: sounds, अक्षर, matras, words and stories.

tracks.title: Discover Nepal
tracks.description: A separate, non-hierarchical course about places, people, seasons and celebrations.

chapters.title: First sounds and social language
chapters.summary: High-utility spoken Nepali from day one: greetings, response words, and the first sound contrasts.

chapters.title: Independent vowels
chapters.summary: The independent vowel letters, their sounds, and their stroke paths.

chapters.title: Consonant families and articulation
chapters.summary: Consonants taught in articulatory families, always inside useful words.

chapters.title: Consonants II and first decodable words
chapters.summary: Glides, liquids, sibilants and the अक्षर workshop that starts real reading.

chapters.title: Vowel signs
chapters.summary: Matra placement, including the visually preposed ि that is pronounced after its consonant.

chapters.title: People, things, and simple sentences
chapters.summary: Pronouns, the copula, plurals, adjectives and the SOV sentence frame.

chapters.title: Family, school, home, and location
chapters.summary: Kinship words, classroom language, postpositions and possession.

chapters.title: Respect, questions, actions, and agreement
chapters.summary: तँ / तिमी / तपाईं as context, never as personal worth; question words, verbs and kind commands.

chapters.title: Conjuncts and fluent decoding
chapters.summary: Halant, common conjuncts, nasal patterns and reading for meaning.

chapters.title: Numbers, money, time, and dates
chapters.summary: Nepali number names 11–99 are irregular; they are taught in frequency chunks, never as a tidy rule.

chapters.title: Food, body, feelings, nature, and routines
chapters.summary: Everyday life language, including safe self-advocacy phrases.

chapters.title: Time frames, conversation, and stories
chapters.summary: Present, past and future patterns culminating in the final language quest.

chapters.title: Ways of greeting, respect, and belonging
chapters.summary: How people greet, host and describe themselves — with variation treated as normal.

chapters.title: Seasons and calendars
chapters.summary: Six ऋतु, the Bikram Sambat year, and how two calendars live side by side.

chapters.title: Land, regions, provinces, and landmarks
chapters.summary: Himal, Pahad and Terai; seven provinces; natural and lived places.

chapters.title: Languages of Nepal
chapters.summary: Language, script and multilingual lives — with listening, not accent guessing.

chapters.title: Peoples and communities
chapters.summary: Introductions, never definitions. Community names do not map to one language, religion, job, face or costume.

chapters.title: Festivals and observances I
chapters.summary: Dashain, Tihar, Holi and Teej — sequences and variation, with dates always tied to a year and source.

chapters.title: Festivals and observances II
chapters.summary: Buddha Jayanti, the plural Lhosars, Chhath, Maghe Sankranti, Janai Purnima and Indra Jatra.

chapters.title: Food and daily life
chapters.summary: Meals, food stories, homes and caring for shared places.

chapters.title: Dress, music, dance, instruments, crafts, and art
chapters.summary: Observation of function, pattern and process — never costume or accent guessing.

chapters.title: Animals, national symbols, and the final project
chapters.summary: Habitats, official symbols, and a child-built learning museum.

modules.title: Namaste world
modules.goal: Greet, give your name, and take two turns in a friendly exchange.

modules.title: Yes, no, please
modules.goal: Respond, request, thank, and repair a conversation politely.

modules.title: Sound detectives I
modules.goal: Hear the difference between aspirated and unaspirated sounds.

modules.title: First vowel shapes
modules.goal: Map अ आ इ ई to sound, picture and stroke path.

lessons.title: Trace and read the mixed set

modules.title: Rounded vowels
modules.goal: Recognize and form उ ऊ ए ऐ ओ औ.

modules.title: Special vowel and marks
modules.goal: Tell vowels apart from nasal and visarga marks.

modules.title: Velars and palatals
modules.goal: Read and form क–ङ and च–ञ inside picture words.

modules.title: Retroflex detectives
modules.goal: Hear and write the retroflex series ट ठ ड ढ ण.

modules.title: Dentals
modules.goal: Distinguish dental त थ द ध न from the retroflex series.

modules.title: Labials
modules.goal: Build words with प फ ब भ म.

modules.title: Glides and liquids
modules.goal: Read य र ल व in word positions and short phrases.

modules.title: Sibilants and h
modules.goal: Recognize श ष स ह and spell common words.

modules.title: Remaining letters and borrowed forms
modules.goal: Meet क्ष त्र ज्ञ and variant letters as whole units.

modules.title: अक्षर workshop
modules.goal: Segment and build controlled words from अक्षर.

modules.title: आ, इ, ई signs
modules.goal: Attach ा ि ी correctly and read real words.

modules.title: उ, ऊ, ऋ signs
modules.goal: Place ु ू ृ below the consonant and read.

modules.title: ए, ऐ, ओ, औ signs
modules.goal: Decode े ै ो ौ inside phrases and a mini story.

modules.title: Matra mastery
modules.goal: Read a controlled short text with automaticity, never speed pressure.

modules.title: Pronouns and “to be”
modules.goal: Say what something is — and is not.

modules.title: Nouns, plurals, classifiers
modules.goal: Use -हरू and counters the way Nepali actually does.

modules.title: Adjectives
modules.goal: Describe color, size and quality.

modules.title: SOV sentence builder
modules.goal: Build subject–object–verb sentences and questions.

modules.title: Families, many ways
modules.goal: Name family members and introduce someone.

modules.title: School and classroom
modules.goal: Follow classroom instructions and ask for an item.

modules.title: Where? Postpositions I
modules.goal: Say where things are.

modules.title: Possession and relations
modules.goal: Use को / का / की, सँग and लाई in real exchanges.

modules.title: Respect ladder
modules.goal: Choose the address level that fits the relationship.

modules.title: Question toolkit
modules.goal: Ask who, what, where, when, why, how and how many.

modules.title: Everyday verbs
modules.goal: Narrate a routine with common verbs.

modules.title: Commands and kindness
modules.goal: Give and follow instructions in the right register.

modules.title: Halant and joining
modules.goal: Split and rebuild conjunct letters.

modules.title: Common conjuncts
modules.goal: Read reph, rakar and frequent clusters.

modules.title: Nasals and homorganic patterns
modules.goal: Hear and spell nasal patterns in real words.

lessons.title: ङ ञ ण न म review

modules.title: Fluency through meaning
modules.goal: Read a new controlled story and answer questions — never a speed race.

modules.title: Digits and 0–10
modules.goal: Match Nepali digits to names and count objects.

modules.title: Teens and tens
modules.goal: Recognize ११–१९ and the round tens.

modules.title: Counting to 100
modules.goal: Recognize sampled numbers across the 21–99 families.

modules.title: Rupees and shopping
modules.goal: Ask prices and complete a fictional market exchange.

modules.title: Clock and daily time
modules.goal: Tell the time and talk about parts of the day.

modules.title: Dates and calendars
modules.goal: Read Bikram Sambat and Gregorian date cards.

modules.title: Food and preferences
modules.goal: Say what you like and what you need at a meal.

modules.title: Body, health, feelings
modules.goal: Name feelings and ask an adult for help.

modules.title: Weather and nature
modules.goal: Give a two-sentence weather report.

modules.title: Daily routine
modules.goal: Order and create a four-step routine.

modules.title: Present patterns
modules.goal: Contrast habitual and ongoing action.

modules.title: Past events
modules.goal: Tell a three-event story about yesterday.

modules.title: Plans and future
modules.goal: Invite a friend and make a plan.

modules.title: Connected story and final language quest
modules.goal: Understand, retell and extend a story built from mastered language.

modules.title: Greetings in context
modules.goal: Notice that people choose greetings for the moment and the relationship.

lessons.title: Greet a guest in a story

modules.title: Respect and hospitality
modules.goal: Make context-sensitive choices as a guest — and ask instead of assuming.

modules.title: Many identities, one classroom
modules.goal: Tell respectful description apart from stereotyping.

modules.title: Six ऋतु
modules.goal: Build the six-season wheel and notice regional differences.

modules.title: Bikram Sambat months 1–6
modules.goal: Order Baisakh–Asoj and read dated cards.

lessons.title: BS as a calendar used in Nepal

modules.title: Bikram Sambat months 7–12
modules.goal: Complete the year and compare calendars.

modules.title: Calendars in daily life
modules.goal: Read a real, versioned calendar page and make an event card.

modules.title: Himal, Pahad, Terai
modules.goal: Place landscapes on a cross-section and explain two differences.

modules.title: Seven provinces
modules.goal: Place all seven provinces with map support.

modules.title: Landmarks: natural
modules.goal: Recognize major mountains, rivers and lakes, and choose conservation actions.

modules.title: Landmarks: lived places
modules.goal: See places as homes with people, not only monuments.

modules.title: A multilingual country
modules.goal: Tell language, script and country apart.

modules.title: Language sampler I
modules.goal: Match labelled speaker clips to taught languages.

modules.title: Language sampler II
modules.goal: Learn that a community name is not one single language.

modules.title: Keep languages thriving
modules.goal: Choose actions that support home languages.

modules.title: What is a community?
modules.goal: Start from equality, then learn the words people use for themselves.

modules.title: Newar, Tamang, Sherpa
modules.goal: Match a person to their own stated details, not to clothing or face.

modules.title: Gurung and Magar
modules.goal: Build accurate “some / may” statements.

modules.title: Tharu and Madhesi identities
modules.goal: Sort broad identity, one language and one region.

modules.title: Rai and Limbu
modules.goal: Learn endonyms and plural languages.

modules.title: Bahun and Chhetri / Khas
modules.goal: Separate description from rank.

lessons.title: Language and religion are not automatic

modules.title: Many more communities
modules.goal: Practise the language of “some”, “many”, “this speaker says”.

lessons.title: How to learn from a person or source

modules.title: Dashain
modules.goal: Arrange a non-exhaustive festival sequence and choose inclusive statements.

lessons.title: Food, swings, and families who do not observe

modules.title: Tihar: days 1–2
modules.goal: Order the first days and choose safe animal care.

modules.title: Tihar: days 3–5
modules.goal: Build the five-day wheel with taught variants.

modules.title: Holi
modules.goal: Choose consent-respecting actions.

modules.title: Teej
modules.goal: Interpret three perspectives without pressure or gender policing.

modules.title: Buddha Jayanti
modules.goal: Link place and observance, and choose a compassionate action.

modules.title: Losar / Lhosar plurality
modules.goal: Match each named observance to its taught community context.

modules.title: Chhath
modules.goal: Sort sunrise and sunset scenes and respectful behavior.

modules.title: Maghe Sankranti
modules.goal: Build a seasonal food table without declaring one menu mandatory.

modules.title: Janai Purnima / Raksha Bandhan / Kwati Punhi
modules.goal: One date, plural observances.

modules.title: Indra Jatra / Yenya Punhi
modules.goal: Read a festival scene and choose respectful spectator behavior.

modules.title: Meals across Nepal
modules.goal: Compare two menus respectfully.

modules.title: Community food stories
modules.goal: Follow a recipe sequence and reject “only X may eat Y”.

modules.title: Homes, school, work, play
modules.goal: Compare lives without poverty spectacle or ranking.

modules.title: Caring for place
modules.goal: Sort actions by impact and make a two-action pledge.

modules.title: Clothing and adornment
modules.goal: Match a garment to its named story and context.

modules.title: Instruments
modules.goal: Match audio to instrument and repeat a rhythm.

modules.title: Songs and dances
modules.goal: Match excerpts to named, community-reviewed examples.

modules.title: Crafts and visual art
modules.goal: Sort materials and processes, and caption with attribution.

modules.title: Animals and habitats
modules.goal: Place animals in plausible habitats and choose conservation actions.

modules.title: National symbols
modules.goal: Identify official symbols and explain one.

modules.title: My Nepal learning museum
modules.goal: Build and privately share a four-topic museum with careful captions.
